lead: An array type takes one parameter, so `array<string, uint>` does not parse and all three diagnostics point at the `<` rather than at the comma.
body: `rule:types/arrays` fixes every key as a `string` — one parameter, not two — so a counter keyed by a column label is `array<uint>`, and no `.nvs` or `.nvst` file in the corpus writes a key type at all. Grep the corpus for the spelling before reaching for a second type argument; a spelling nothing uses is usually one nothing parses.
